"LGBT culture in Paris"
LGBT culture in Paris LGBT culture in France is centred on Paris, the capital city, where there is an active LGBT community. In the 1990s, 46% of France's gay men lived in Paris. As of 2004, Paris had 140 LGBT bars, clubs, hotels, restaurants, shops, and other commercial businesses. Florence Tamagne, author of ""Paris: 'Resting on its Laurels'?"", wrote that there is a """"Gaité parisienne""""; she added that Paris ""competes with Berlin for the title of LGBT capital of Europe, and ranks only second behind New York for the title of LGBT capital of the world.""
